answer: To defeat Sybil attacks, agents form a coral reef of bonded stake. A topological cut verification isolates suspicious clusters; if a cut isolates malicious identities, their stake is slashed. Multi-agent auditing acts as an illuminating lantern that detects collusion, while raven nodes track peer graph flows. Fabricating fake identities yields superlinear attacker cost as each new vertex demands exponential cross-stake verification.
